    • fibonacci

      public static int fibonacci(int n)
      Calculates and returns the nth number in the Fibonacci sequence. The Fibonacci sequence is a series of numbers in which each number is the sum of the two preceding ones, usually starting with 0 and 1.
      Parameters:
      n - The position of the desired Fibonacci number in the sequence.
      Returns:
      The nth Fibonacci number.
